name: B2B Multi-Signal Lead Intent Qualification with Jev

parameters.content:
## B2B Multi-Signal Lead Intent Qualification with Jev

### How it works

This workflow performs B2B lead intent qualification by reading leads, normalizing them, enriching them with company and ICP data, and computing a deterministic rule score. It then sends the scored lead to Jev for AI judgement, combines the AI result with the rule score, assigns a final tier, and routes the lead to the appropriate follow-up action. Final decisions are also logged back to Google Sheets with a run summary.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Sheets credentials and configure the source lead sheet, enrichment sheet, ICP rules sheet, and logging sheet used by the workflow.
- Configure the Jev Judge HTTP request with the correct BeatAPI/Jev endpoint, authentication headers, and request body fields expected by the API.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the channels or recipients for AE alerts and manual review alerts.
- Connect Gmail credentials and configure the T2 soft-touch email sender, recipient fields, subject, and body template.
- Connect WhatsApp credentials and configure the message destination and template for top-tier lead outreach.
- Review the Limit node settings to control how many leads are processed per manual test run.

### Customization

Adjust the ICP rules, enrichment fields, rule-score logic, tier thresholds, and routing branches to match your sales qualification model and outreach playbook.


@[youtube](gkmJcqw7Yrg)

## Manual test trigger

Starts the workflow manually for testing or batch qualification runs.

## Lead intake normalization

Reads raw leads from Google Sheets and converts different lead formats into a unified structure for downstream scoring.

## Enrichment and rule scoring

Pulls company enrichment and ICP rule data, merges it with the normalized lead, and calculates a deterministic 0-100 rule-based score.

## AI judgement decision

Limits the run volume, sends the scored lead to Jev for AI evaluation, and combines the AI judgement with the rule score to determine the final tier and route.

## Tiered outreach routing

Branches by final tier and triggers the appropriate action, including WhatsApp outreach followed by a Slack AE alert for top-tier leads, a soft-touch Gmail email for second-tier leads, or a Slack review alert.

## Lead logging summary

Records the final lead qualification result in Google Sheets and produces a compact summary of the run.
